prompts: Use case style-transfer. Create a standalone hyperrealistic photographic character portrait for a game magazine, based ONLY on the illustrated character in the supplied magazine screenshot. Do not reproduce the magazine page, labels, typography, other character or layout. This should look like a high-end live-action cinematic promotional photograph, not cartoon, painting or 3D plastic. Natural skin pores, individual hair, believable cloth weave, understated workwear wear. Chest-up framing, whole head with generous headroom, shoulders visible, subject looking at camera in subtle three-quarter pose. Soft directional studio light with subtle cool rim, restrained neutral charcoal/teal softly blurred workshop backdrop. Matching series composition, eye level lens85mm, sharp eyes, realistic human proportions. Portrait4:5 highresolution. No text, logos, tools blocking face, glasses or sunglasses. Render ONLY TONY, the dark-haired character on LEFT of screenshot. Preserve his recognizable illustrated face and angular jaw, thick dark eyebrows, hazel eyes, swept-up short dark brown hair, light natural stubble, confident relaxed slight smile. Fit working build, navy blue collared work shirt with chest pockets over charcoal undershirt, sleeves rolled. NO overalls. Mature adult plumber, not teenage model. Translate illustrated design into photographic realism without using any real-person photo.
